question: The drug Diclofenac is one of the prime reasons for wiping out most of the ________ population in India.
solution:
The correct answer is **'__vulture__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Diclofenac **was once used as a livestock anti-inflammatory drug, but its usage has been banned in India since 2006.
 
• The vulture got **exposed to this drug** by eating the carcass of animals that have been treated with diclofenac in recent times.
 
• **Diclofenac **leads to **renal failure **in vultures **damaging their excretory system**.
 
• Thus, it **leads to the wiping out **of most of the **vulture population** in India.
